name: Campfire Banana Boat
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Peel back a 1 ½ inch (4 cm) wide strip of peel from the inside curve of the banana, leaving one end attached to the banana.
Cut out and remove a wedge-shaped cavity from the length of the banana.
Fill cavity with mini-marshmallows and chocolate chips
Replace peel and wrap well in heavy duty foil.
Place on coals for about 5 minutes.
Open carefully and eat with a spoon right from the banana peel.
